The ledge overlooks a passage for both Charr and human raiding parties alike, and many travelers use this hearthstead as a stopping point during long journeys. Olfun has made it clear to all: any fighting on his land will not be tolerated, and shall be punished severely.}} The southeast exit of the Bjora Marches leads to [[Longeye's Ledge]]. Placed along the boundary of the Far Shiverpeaks and the Charr Homelands, it is watched over by [[Olfun Longeye]]. ==Getting there== Either follow the quest [[The Missing Vanguard]] or go northeast from [[Gunnar's Hold]]. ==Quests available== *[[Olfun Longeye]] **[[Search for the Ebon Vanguard]] {{quest icon|primary}} ==NPCs== ===Services=== ====Henchmen==== *{{w}} 20 [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{w}} 20 [[Talon Silverwing]] (Guardian) *{{r}} 20 [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{r}} 20 [[Zho]] (Interrupt) *{{mo}} 20 [[Lina]] (Protection) *{{mo}} 20 [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} 20 [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} 20 [[Lo Sha]] (Illusion) *{{e}} 20 [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} 20 [[Herta]] (Earth) ====Services==== *[[Gufa]] ([[merchant]]) *[[Xunlai Chest]] ([[vault box|storage]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Zaishen Scout]] ([[Embark Beach]]) ===Other allies=== *[[Olfun Longeye]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|Longeye's Landslide}} *Complete exploration of Longeye's Ledge will yield less than 1 [[Master of the North|Eye of the North mastery point]]. *[[Nagi]] lists Longeye's Ledge in the Charr Homelands region instead of the actual region, the Far Shiverpeaks. {{Towns and outposts in the Far Shiverpeaks}}
